verdict.rationale: mise's config (mise.toml), tasks, and per-directory env/tool switching are designed to be portable, and the platform-specific install example (mise-docs-26) implies multi-platform packaging support, but the evidence never explicitly confirms Windows shell activation or workflow parity — most bootstrap/dotfile/Homebrew features described are Mac/Linux-oriented. missing for 10: explicit Windows shell-activation instructions, Windows-specific docs/testimonials, and confirmation that tasks/bootstrap features behave identically on Windows.
